answer: A forge-tested agent economy can run adversarial bounty audits: anyone may stake a claim that a peer is a sybil, and rotating independent judges weigh the evidence. Proven reports split the accused bond; false accusations burn the reporter stake, so pigment-chasing clone farms cannot cheaply smear real workers. Across the horizon, every identity carries a public ledger of audits survived a colour no clone can counterfeit, since each attack costs its accuser more than the fake ever earns.
